detail.longDescription: Your AI agent can already draft replies, summarize a long thread, and flag what's urgent. But when the chat ends, so does the help. Someone still has to save the attachment, log the new lead, and send the follow-up after the meeting. Now you can set up email automation from the AI tool you already use. Install Zapier in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor, tell your agent what should happen to your email, and it builds the automation for you. Zapier runs it from there, even after you close the chat. And
